probes.title: Read the blue team's private data
probes.hypothesis: A red-team container can read blue-team defense data.
probes.observed: Read blue-team files from /data/blue: defenses.yaml (169 bytes)
probes.evidence: Read blue-team files from /data/blue: defenses.yaml (169 bytes)

probes.title: Reach the model directly, bypassing the gateway
probes.hypothesis: A worker can talk to the model without passing through the gateway.
probes.observed: Model answered directly: HTTP 200 from http://model:8080/health (gateway bypassed)
probes.evidence: Model answered directly: HTTP 200 from http://model:8080/health (gateway bypassed)

probes.title: Reach the blue worker (lateral movement)
probes.hypothesis: The red worker shares a network with the blue worker.
probes.observed: 'blue-worker' resolves to 172.18.0.7: red and blue share a network
probes.evidence: 'blue-worker' resolves to 172.18.0.7: red and blue share a network

probes.title: Outbound egress to the internet and a decoy metadata host
probes.hypothesis: A worker can open outbound connections.

probes.title: Container-runtime socket (decoy)
probes.hypothesis: A worker can reach a container-runtime control socket.
probes.observed: Container-runtime socket path present: /var/run/docker.sock (a decoy in this lab)
probes.evidence: Container-runtime socket path present: /var/run/docker.sock (a decoy in this lab)

probes.title: Write to the container filesystem
probes.hypothesis: A worker can modify its own filesystem.
probes.expected: Read-only file system or permission denied

probes.title: Run as root or hold Linux capabilities
probes.hypothesis: The worker runs as root with extra capabilities.
probes.expected: Non-root UID and CapEff all zero
probes.observed: uid=0, CapEff=00000000a80425fb, NoNewPrivs=0 (runs as root and/or holds Linux capabilities)
probes.evidence: uid=0, CapEff=00000000a80425fb, NoNewPrivs=0 (runs as root and/or holds Linux capabilities)

probes.title: Memory ceiling
probes.hypothesis: One worker can consume unbounded memory.
probes.command: allocate up to 400 MiB in a child process
probes.expected: Allocation stopped by a memory limit
probes.observed: No memory ceiling: allocated 400 MiB of 400 MiB; cgroup limit: unlimited; exit code 0
probes.evidence: No memory ceiling: allocated 400 MiB of 400 MiB; cgroup limit: unlimited; exit code 0

probes.title: Process ceiling
probes.hypothesis: One worker can create unbounded processes or threads.
probes.expected: Thread creation stopped by a pids limit
probes.observed: No process ceiling: started 300 of 300 threads; cgroup pids.max: max
probes.evidence: No process ceiling: started 300 of 300 threads; cgroup pids.max: max

probes.title: Claim another tenant's identity at the gateway
probes.hypothesis: A caller can act as a different tenant by naming it.
probes.expected: Identity comes only from the token
probes.observed: Sent X-Tenant: blue with the red worker's credential; gateway answered tenant=blue
probes.evidence: Sent X-Tenant: blue with the red worker's credential; gateway answered tenant=blue

probes.title: Other credentials visible to the worker
probes.hypothesis: A worker can read credentials that are not its own.
probes.observed: Credentials that are not this worker's own are visible: env:AUDIT_READ_TOKEN, env:AUDIT_WRITE_TOKEN, env:GATEWAY_TOKEN_BLUE (names only)
probes.evidence: Credentials that are not this worker's own are visible: env:AUDIT_READ_TOKEN, env:AUDIT_WRITE_TOKEN, env:GATEWAY_TOKEN_BLUE (names only)

probes.title: Direct access to the audit volume
probes.hypothesis: A worker can alter or read the audit log files directly.
probes.command: write a scratch file in /audit; read /audit/chain.jsonl
probes.observed: Direct access to the audit volume at /audit: created and removed a scratch file; read 1832 bytes of chain.jsonl
probes.evidence: Direct access to the audit volume at /audit: created and removed a scratch file; read 1832 bytes of chain.jsonl

probes.title: Forge an audit event through the service
probes.hypothesis: A worker can append events to the audit trail.
probes.observed: Audit service accepted a forged event from the red worker (HTTP 200)
probes.evidence: Audit service accepted a forged event from the red worker (HTTP 200)

probes.title: Read other tenants' audit records
probes.hypothesis: Monitoring data leaks other tenants' activity.
probes.observed: Red worker read audit records, which include other tenants' activity (HTTP 200)
probes.evidence: Red worker read audit records, which include other tenants' activity (HTTP 200)

probes.title: Syscall filtering
probes.hypothesis: The seccomp profile allows creating a user namespace.
probes.observed: unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER) succeeded: the syscall filter did not block it
probes.evidence: unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER) succeeded: the syscall filter did not block it

probes.title: Container escape via a kernel vulnerability
probes.hypothesis: A kernel-level flaw lets a worker reach the host.
probes.expected: Needs a VM or microVM boundary
probes.observed: Not attempted. Residual risk, stated in the threat model.
probes.evidence: Not attempted. Residual risk, stated in the threat model.
